description: Descriptive five-minute OHLC path after the first hourly touch of each frozen NY-month first-week outer 1.618 rail. This is observation only, not a trading backtest.
ready_time_rule: ready_ms is derived, not supplied by events.csv.gz: the end of the first complete NY Monday-Sunday week, at the following Monday 00:00 America/New_York. Before trusting the recorded H1 first-touch hour, inspect local 5m bars from ready_ms up to (excluding) that hour start. Any same-side rail touch in that interval is separately marked and excluded from A/B/C; incomplete history is retained only with an explicit H1-first-touch-only basis label.

observation.first_touch_rule: Within the frozen UTC touch hour, lower side first 5m low <= outer rail; upper side first 5m high >= outer rail. Require a complete 5m timestamp prefix from the hour start through the candidate touch bar, so all earlier bars in that hour are observable and did not touch first.
observation.classification_window: The first touch bar and its next five complete consecutive 5m bars (six bars total); all six must remain in the event's NY calendar month.
observation.strict_reclaim_rule: Lower side close > outer rail; upper side close < outer rail. Equality is not a reclaim.

categories.A: First touch bar closes strictly back inside the rail.
categories.B: First strict inside close occurs in one of the next five bars.
categories.C: No strict inside close in the six-bar window.

observation.near_boundary_followup: For A/B, examine the next 12 complete consecutive 5m bars after the first reclaim bar, within the same NY month. Count reaching the first-week near-side boundary from beyond the 1.618 rail (lower side: high >= first_week_low; upper side: low <= first_week_high). Exclude cases where the reclaim bar itself already reached that boundary; report incomplete windows separately.

costs: Not applicable; descriptive OHLC observation, no simulated fills or PnL.
